items.title: Breaking: Two killed in light plane crash at Parafield Airport in Adelaide's north
items.description: Two people are dead and a "number of others" have injuries after a plane crash at Parafield Airport in Adelaide's north.

items.title: 'Extremely corrosive': Trump called out for remarks aimed at Australia
items.description: US Congressman Joe Courtney says the US president's repeated criticism of Australia is "unfair" and causing harm to the US amongst its allies.

items.title: Threat to homes eases as fire in northern NSW downgraded
items.description: The threat posed to homes by a grass fire burning on the state's Northern Tablelands eases as the Emergency alert is downgraded to Watch and Act.

items.title: Australia's richest woman gifts plane to Pauline Hanson
items.description: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson banks more than $3 million worth of donations, including a brand-new plane gifted by Australia's richest person, Gina Rinehart.

items.title: Inflation details may give RBA pause for thought on interest rates
items.description: While inflation remains well above the Reserve Bank's target, there are details in the numbers that may give it reasons to hold off another rate hike in May.

items.title: NT Police say some in community 'absolutely know' where suspected abductor is
items.description: Northern Territory Police say some people in the community "absolutely know" where missing five-year-old girl Sharon Granites's suspected abductor is, and are imploring anyone with information that could help find them to come forward.

items.title: Mother of alleged double killer Beau Lamarre-Condon charged
items.description: The mother of a former police officer accused of killing Sydney couple Jesse Baird and Luke Davies has been charged after allegedly attempting to influence a key witness.

items.title: Rebel Wilson accused of dumping her mobile to avoid handing over key texts
items.description: Ms Wilson's lawyers have previously told Federal Court defamation hearing that her phone was stolen and she was unable to produce all of her WhatsApp message history.

items.title: King's speech to Congress hits on several Trump controversies
items.description: In a speech that was supposed to be apolitical, King Charles hits on some hot-button issues that are fuelling controversies around the Trump administration.

items.title: What is OPEC? Why is the UAE leaving it?
items.description: The UAE is leaving an international oil-producers' group that has a major influence on the price of oil around the world.

items.title: Three Melbourne teens charged over alleged attempted kidnapping
items.description: Police say the trio are linked to targeted attacks on promoters of a weekly event held in South Melbourne.

items.title: AFL pushes ahead with draft changes and not everyone is happy
items.description: The AFL is pushing ahead with draft and player-movement changes for this off-season, with Carlton president Rob Priestly and Western Bulldogs coach Luke Beveridge criticising the move.

items.title: Docker Nathan O'Driscoll reveals mental health struggles
items.description: Fremantle Dockers player Nathan O'Driscoll reveals his mental health struggles in an emotional social media post, amid a push from players for the AFL to implement a mental health round.

items.title: Ultra-swimmer sets world record with 55km solo feat in crocodile-filled river
items.description: Andy Donaldson took less than 12 hours to swim the challenging 55-kilometre course down the Upper Ord River in Western Australia's north.

items.title: What you can do if you are worried about a neighbour's dog
items.description: An unhappy dog doesn't necessarily mean criminal neglect, even if the level of care is below what you would give your own pet.

items.title: Everything you need to know about this year's winter vaccine rollout
items.description: With winter just around the corner, now is the perfect time to get vaccinated against seasonal flu and other viruses.

items.title: Flirtation turns to something much darker in show set at Australian Open
items.description: What starts as a rom-com set at the Australian Open turns into a searing indictment of race relations in Australia in the new show Game. Set. Match.

items.title: Acts of courage during Wieambilla tragedy honoured with police bravery awards
items.description: Police officers and civilians have been honoured for acts of courage during the Wieambilla shootings — which left two officers and a neighbour dead — at a police ceremony in Dalby.

items.title: Former Olympic swimming physio to stand trial for alleged child sex offences
items.description: Peter John Wells, 55, pleaded not guilty to one count of sexual assault, and five counts of maintaining a sexual relationship with a child.

items.title: Former police officer loses appeal over assaulting teenagers during arrest
items.description: A former NSW police officer has failed in an attempt to overturn a conviction for using unreasonable force in the arrest of two teenage boys.

items.title: Tim Picton's accused killer pleads not guilty to manslaughter
items.description: The man accused of killing former Labor identity Tim Picton outside a Northbridge venue has pleaded not guilty to his manslaughter.

items.title: High fuel costs a 'kick in the guts' for country clubs, but the game must go on
items.description: Country sporting clubs are rallying to help families keep coming to fixtures as fuel prices double, with some travelling up to 640km. But it's a hefty cost regional and rural families are prepared to take on if it means maintaining their sporting commitments which are so integral to mental wellbeing and social connectivity.

items.title: More women come forward after sepsis case linked to pedicure
items.description: More Perth women share their experience of needing surgery after having an adverse reaction to nail salon services, triggering a warning from the consumer watchdog.

items.title: AI deepfakes are in our schools. What's the right way to handle them?
items.description: Deepfake content, made from artificial intelligence, is increasingly circulating in schools. But what can parents do if their children are the target?

items.title: Long wait for SA upper house result creating 'confusion and uncertainty'
items.description: With less than a week until state parliament resumes, an incoming upper house member says she still cannot access the building or appoint staff because the election result is yet to be declared.
